description: Resolve a company domain to Instagram, Threads and Facebook accounts and counts.

tool_signatures.name: map_meta_brand_presence
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a company domain to its Instagram, Threads and Facebook accounts with follower and post counts, as one flat Clay ready row. The Threads handle is derived from the resolved Instagram handle at no extra discovery cost. Instagram and Threads counts are rounded by Meta and the row carries both the rounded integer and the platform

company_domain.description: Bare company domain, for example shopify.com. Supply this or a handle. With a domain the actor runs full discovery; with a handle it skips straight to the fetch.

company_name.description: Optional. Improves search accuracy and is what the identity gate checks a discovered profile against, so supplying it reduces wrong matches.

handle.description: Optional. The Instagram handle with or without the leading @. Supplying it skips Instagram discovery AND gives Threads its handle for free, because Threads handles are Instagram handles (5 of 5 measured).

platforms.description: Which of the three Meta surfaces to map. Default is all three. Dropping Facebook is the common choice: it is the least reliable of the three and it costs a fetch to find that out.

includeFollowerCounts.description: Default true: the profile page is fetched and the follower counts are extracted. Set false to resolve the profile URL only, which is cheaper and needs no proxy.

skipCache.description: Default false: a successful lookup is cached for seven days and reused. Set true to force a fresh fetch.
